title: Sandwich KIRA-ELISA Protocol
author: Umed T Boltaev
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rprd5m6
materials: Firmly blot plate against clean paper towels.
SIncubate at room temperature for 1 hour. 01:00:00

steps.title: Coat ELISA Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare two high affinity, protein-binding ELISA plates (e.g., NUNC Immulon 4 HBX): one 'pY Plate' and one 'Total Protein' plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute unlabeled capture antibody to a final concentration of 0.5 – 8 µg/ml in PBS.
For the pY plate, use Sino Biological Anti-TrkB Antibody (Catalog #10047-RP02) at a 1/1000 dilution.
For the total protein plate, use R&D Systems/Thermo Fisher Scientific TrkB Goat anti-Human Polyclonal Antibody (Catalog #AF397) at a 1/500 dilution.
Transfer 100 µl of the respective diluted antibody to each well.

steps.title: Incubate Capture Antibody
steps.instruction: Seal the plates to prevent evaporation and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 4°C overnight, or for 2-3 hours at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Prepare Plates for Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove capture antibody and block the plates.

substeps.instruction: Bring the plates to room temperature.
Flick off the capture antibody solution.
Seal the plates and incubate at room temperature for ≥ 1 hour.

steps.title: Add Lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer lysate from the experimental plate (where cells were treated) to the pY and total protein (receptor) plates.

substeps.instruction: Seal the plates and incubate at 4°C overnight.
Perform at least 3 washes using a squirt bottle, carboy, manifold dispenser, multi-channel pipettor, or automatic plate washer.
For increased stringency: after each wash, let the plate stand briefly, flick off the buffer, and blot plates on paper towels before refilling.

steps.title: Add Detection Antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute the detection antibody to 0.25 – 2 µg/ml in Blocking Solution and add 100 µl to each well.

substeps.instruction: For the pY plate: prepare a 1/2500 dilution (4 µl of Ab stock to 10 ml of 1% BSA PBS/Tween).
For primary cultures on the pY plate: reduce the dilution to 1/1250 (8 µl of Ab stock to 10 ml of 1% BSA PBS/Tween).
For the total protein (receptor) plate: prepare the working dilution of detecting Ab (ensure capturing and detecting antibodies are from different host animals).

steps.title: Wash Plates
steps.instruction: Wash with PBS/Tween (5x), performing at least 3 washes.

steps.title: Add Enzyme Conjugate
steps.instruction: Dilute the Av-HRP conjugate (Cat. No. 405103) or other enzyme conjugate (e.g., Cell Signaling Technology Anti-rabbit IgG, HRP-linked Antibody Catalog #7074) to its pre-determined optimal concentration in Blocking Buffer (usually 1/500 – 1/2000).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of the diluted conjugate per well.
Seal the plate and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash Plates
steps.instruction: Wash with PBS/Tween (5x), performing at least 5 washes.

steps.title: Develop Color and Read OD
steps.instruction: Perform color development and read the optical density.

substeps.instruction: Add TMB One solution (Promega Catalog #G7431) and incubate for 30 min at RT.
Add 1N HCl solution to stop the reaction.
Read the optical density (OD) for each well with a microplate reader set to 405 nm.

steps.title: Secondary Analysis/Repeat
steps.instruction: Perform additional washes and TMB development if required by the specific assay variant.

substeps.instruction: Wash with PBS/Tween (5x).
Wash with PBS/Tween (5x).
Add 1% BSA PBS solution.
Add TMB One solution (Promega Catalog #G7431) and incubate for 5-30 min at RT.
Add 1N HCl solution.
Read the optical density (OD) for each well with a microplate reader set to 405 nm.
